questions.q: What do you tune before PID?
questions.explain: PID amplifies everything from the gyro, noise included. A clean spectrum comes first.
Measured as the opposite-sign peak within 150 ms after the stop / maneuver amplitude.

questions.q: Why use the median over maneuvers for metrics rather than the mean?
options: An outlier doesn't ruin the estimate
The mean isn't available in Blackbox Explorer
questions.explain: The median is robust to outliers.

questions.q: In the case study, the SHARP profile gave 7 ms less entry lag. At what price?
options: Loss of link at the edge of range
questions.explain: Raising P raises the gain at all frequencies, including residual noise.

questions.q: Why didn't the WASH profile (more D) reduce propwash on a 1.4 kg 7"?
options: Not enough throttle to execute D
questions.explain: The numbers: RMS 0.97 of the control — within measurement noise.

questions.q: How was crispness eventually brought back without more noise?
options: Removed the RPM filter to gain phase
questions.explain: The CRISP profile: gyro multiplier 1.10, notch Q 450 — same PID, less phase delay.

questions.q: Two “identical” drones gave different bounce-back. The lesson?
options: The metric is broken and unfit for comparison
questions.explain: Compare profiles within a single flight or normalize to the amplitude: the pilot flew harder on one, and D-max had time to kick in.

questions.q: How many changes are allowed per tuning flight?
questions.explain: Otherwise the log can't be interpreted.

options: Normal for a 7" on big props

questions.q: A pilot complains about “jitter” in hover. What does this fragment of grader output tell you?
questions.fragment:
[PASS] tracking roll tracking error: 0.12 (limit <= 0.25)
[FAIL] tracking roll rate with centred sticks: 14.6 (limit <= 6.0 deg/s)
[FAIL] tracking pitch rate with centred sticks: 14.1 (limit <= 6.0 deg/s)
[PASS] filters  roll noise after filters: 2.1
options: Tracking and noise are fine, but a wobble remains in hover — the loop is on the edge, check P relative to D
Motor noise gets through the filters and shakes the aircraft — lower the gyro LPF frequencies
The motors saturate in hover, so the loop has no headroom left for stabilization
There's no eRPM telemetry, so the RPM filter is off, and the hover jitter comes from motor harmonics
questions.explain: Tracking and noise are fine, but movement remains in hover — a sign of loop oscillation, not noise.
